captions.caption: A slender tornado funnel descends from dark, swirling clouds over a grassy field.
The tornado funnel makes contact with the ground, kicking up dust and debris.
A wide shot captures the full length of the tornado funnel under the storm base.
The tornado continues to rotate steadily as it moves across the landscape.
The camera pans to show the road leading toward the distant tornado.
The tornado funnel appears thin and rope-like against the dark sky.
A car drives along the road with the tornado visible in the distance.
Multiple vehicles are seen on the road as the tornado persists.
The tornado's rotation is visible in the dark, rotating cloud base.
Dust and debris are pulled into the base of the tornado funnel.
The camera follows the tornado as it moves over the open fields.
The tornado funnel remains well-defined and continues to swirl.
The view shifts slightly as the camera car moves forward.
The tornado is seen from a further perspective, still touching the ground.
The tornado funnel stretches and bends as it moves across the field.
The camera car keeps the tornado in view while driving on the road.
A cloud of dust and debris surrounds the base of the tornado.
Intense rotation is visible where the tornado meets the ground.
The tornado continues its path across the flat, open landscape.
The funnel cloud remains a thin, dark line connecting clouds to earth.
A vehicle passes the camera car on the wet road.
The tornado is partially obscured by rain and low-hanging clouds.
Debris continues to swirl at the base of the tornado funnel.
The tornado funnel appears to weaken or become less distinct.
Swirling dust marks the location of the tornado on the ground.
The storm clouds remain dark and ominous over the fields.
The tornado funnel becomes more visible and defined once again.
Two distinct funnel clouds are seen descending from the same storm.
Both funnel clouds rotate and reach toward the ground simultaneously.
The camera zooms in on the primary, more prominent tornado funnel.
The tornado funnel is clearly visible against the dark storm background.
The view transitions to a dashcam perspective from inside a moving car.
The dashcam captures the car driving along a wet road toward the tornado.
Rain falls on the windshield as the car approaches the tornado.
The tornado funnel is seen through the windshield, moving across the road.
The car continues its approach, with the tornado clearly visible ahead.
The tornado funnel remains prominent as the car gets closer.
The dashcam shows the wide, flat landscape surrounding the road.
The tornado appears to be crossing the road directly in front of the car.
The car slows down as it nears the path of the tornado.
The tornado funnel is very close, filling the view through the windshield.
The car passes a red car stopped on the side of the road.
The tornado funnel is seen just to the side of the road.
Debris swirls violently on the ground near the tornado.
The car continues driving past the tornado's location.
The tornado is seen moving away from the road in the dashcam view.
The car stops as the tornado crosses the road ahead.
A close-up shot shows the tornado funnel crossing the road.
Debris is blown across the road by the intense tornado winds.
The tornado funnel is dark, wide, and filled with debris.
Intense rotation is visible within the core of the tornado.
The tornado moves off the road and back into the field.
The camera captures the tornado moving away from the camera's position.
The tornado funnel remains visible in the distance as it recedes.
The camera pans back toward the road where the car is stopped.
The dashcam view returns, showing the road after the tornado's passage.
The car begins to move forward again on the wet pavement.
The tornado is still visible in the distance, moving further away.
The dashcam captures the surrounding fields as the storm recedes.
The car continues driving as the tornado fades into the distance.
